--- call_optional_named_tvf.sql
GRAPH FinGraph
MATCH (p:Person)
OPTIONAL CALL graph.neighbors(p)
RETURN p.name

--- AST
&ast.GQLGraphQuery{
  GraphClause: &ast.GQLGraphClause{
    PropertyGraphName: &ast.Path{
      Idents: []*ast.Ident{
        &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 6,
          NameEnd: 14,
          Name:    "FinGraph",
        },
      },
    },
  },
  Query: &ast.GQLMultiLinearQueryStatement{
    Statements: []ast.GQLLinearQueryStatement{
      &ast.GQLSimpleLinearQueryStatement{
        Statements: []ast.GQLPrimitiveQueryStatement{
          &ast.GQLMatch{
            Optional: -1,
            Match:    15,
            Pattern:  &ast.GQLGraphPattern{
              Paths: []*ast.GQLTopLevelPathPattern{
                &ast.GQLTopLevelPathPattern{
                  Path: &ast.GQLPathPattern{
                    Terms: []*ast.GQLPathTerm{
                      &ast.GQLPathTerm{
                        Primary: &ast.GQLNodePattern{
                          Lparen:  21,
                          Rparen:  30,
                          Pattern: &ast.GQLElementPatternFiller{
                            EmptyPos: -1,
                            Variable: &ast.Ident{
                              NamePos: 22,
                              NameEnd: 23,
                              Name:    "p",
                            },
                            Label: &ast.GQLLabelFilter{
                              Is:    -1,
                              Colon: 23,
                              Expr:  &ast.GQLNameLabel{
                                Name: &ast.Ident{
                                  NamePos: 24,
                                  NameEnd: 30,
                                  Name:    "Person",
                                },
                              },
                            },
                          },
                        },
                      },
                    },
                  },
                },
              },
            },
          },
          &ast.GQLTVFCall{
            Optional: 32,
            Call:     41,
            Per:      -1,
            TVF:      &ast.TVFCallExpr{
              Rparen: 63,
              Name:   &ast.Path{
                Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                  &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 46,
                    NameEnd: 51,
                    Name:    "graph",
                  },
                  &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 52,
                    NameEnd: 61,
                    Name:    "neighbors",
                  },
                },
              },
              Args: []ast.TVFArg{
                &ast.ExprArg{
                  Expr: &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 62,
                    NameEnd: 63,
                    Name:    "p",
                  },
                },
              },
            },
          },
          &ast.GQLReturn{
            Return: 65,
            Items:  []*ast.GQLReturnItem{
              &ast.GQLReturnItem{
                Star: -1,
                Expr: &ast.Path{
                  Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                    &ast.Ident{
                      NamePos: 72,
                      NameEnd: 73,
                      Name:    "p",
                    },
                    &ast.Ident{
                      NamePos: 74,
                      NameEnd: 78,
                      Name:    "name",
                    },
                  },
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
GRAPH FinGraph MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL CALL graph.neighbors(p) RETURN p.name
